notes:
REF-BM-02: Only a hostname fallback and externally derived favicon are provided; page title, description, and preview metadata are not collected.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but no note field exists.
REF-BM-06: Creating an existing URL produces another bookmark with no duplicate detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, URL, and tags, but not notes.
REF-BM-14: #tag query syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized expressions are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed and quote characters are searched literally.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: There is no mark-as-read action.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk action support.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Results are always sorted by creation date descending; users cannot choose another sort key.
REF-BM-23: No bookmark note or Markdown rendering is implemented.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or action exists.
REF-BM-27: Deletion is permanent, but there is no reversible archive operation to distinguish from it.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-only list.
REF-BM-29: Bundles and saved filter combinations are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: No display-related personal settings are available.
